integrity: Analytical proof for arbitrary dimension and lattice length; finite exact checks are supporting evidence, not proof of universal quantifiers. All journal and preprint results cited with their actual provenance. No claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to bijective affine rules over characteristic-two vector spaces and includes the carrier. It does not classify nonlinear admissible rules or independently verify all possible earlier equivalent presentations. The free preprint was read in full; some later sources were inaccessible in full.
title: Complete cycle census for additive-affine helical Yang–Baxter automata
